review_type: Independent read-only source review; report-only write
findings: Manual thumb updates do not run automatic intro/outro logic; programmatic playback updates retain existing automatic behavior behind a state gate.
Polling returns before changing progress or labels during active dragging and bounded seek settling.
Final target is stored independently of the widget and committed once; invalid duration/target and stale source or episode releases are rejected.
New playback and pause reset state; repeated reset retains cancellation identity until old release is consumed.
Gesture displacement uses a latched playback origin and remains in the current episode; release without an active gesture cannot restart it.
Child SeekBar ACTION_CANCEL is cancelled before super dispatch; the same event and original dispatch result are preserved, and null access is guarded.
New smali argument ranges and register types match actual helper and bundled player APIs.
Public StandardGSYVideoPlayer retains native drag/timer guards and one commit; no corresponding legacy skip conflict found.
Existing accurate-seek option remains enabled; no unverified decoder tuning or public-player behavior changes.
remaining_risks: No hardware playback, actual buffering latency, physical touch cancellation, codec seek accuracy or frame timing measured.
The bounded settle guard returns to actual decoder time after four seconds if the target has not been reached.
